fusions.name: Bar Rattler
fusions.desc: Butts the target 3 tiles back for 14 damage, then leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hem Them In
fusions.desc: Stamps your hooves around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Slipped the Pen
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Shut Gate
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
